Name: Odalys Fenwright

The Creek Field Trip

On our field trip to the creek we looked for salamanders under the rocks. Our guide showed us how to lift a rock slowly and put it back the same way so the animals stay safe. I found two salamanders and a crayfish. We tested the water and it was cold and clear, which the guide said means the creek is healthy. i think every class should go to the creek because you learn more by seeing animals than by reading about them. The bus ride was long but it was worth it
